text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall, but one month’s gain or loss does not predict the next; I should make decisions for long-term stability, not react to short-term moves.","Selling some appreciated shares has realized gains, but I should check that my holdings remain diversified and that I keep enough cash for living expenses.","Since I value steady savings and have not been an active trader, I should trade deliberately and avoid unnecessary frequent buying or selling."]}
